title: Senior Product Manager - AI Gateway
location: Berlin Office, Bosnia, Romania, Norway, Estonia, Latvia, Slovenia, Netherlands, Hungary, Portugal, Poland, Serbia, Germany, Austria, Finland, Albania, Lithuania, Slovakia, Ireland, Bulgaria, Denmark, Belgium, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Croatia, Spain, Greece
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.
n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.
We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
AI is now part of almost every workflow built on n8n. But before a new user can build their first AI automation, they often hit a wall: sign up with a model provider, create an API key, add billing, and paste credentials into n8n. Many people never get past that step.
The Relay team removes that wall. With Gateway credits, n8n Cloud users get leading AI models and services such as web search, scraping and document parsing built in, with no keys to manage. A new user can open a template or ask the AI assistant to build something, and it just works on day one.
MAKE DAY-ONE SUCCESS THE DEFAULT
 - Own the Gateway credits experience end to end: from sign-up to first successful AI workflow or Agent, to ongoing usage.
 - Remove credential friction across the product. Work with the Growth, Agents and n8n Assistant teams so new users land on services that work out of the box.
 - Decide which models and services we offer, and how we price and package them for users..
BUILD AND RUN PROVIDER PARTNERSHIPS
 - Own relationships with model and tool providers, from first conversation to signed deal.
 - Lead commercial negotiations, including volume commitments, pricing and terms.
 - Partner with Finance on commitment approvals and consumption forecasting.
 - Decide when to add, expand or drop a provider, based on user demand, quality and cost.
SHAPE THE ENTERPRISE AI GATEWAY
 - Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects: platform teams, IT and security leads, and AI owners.
 - Turn what you learn into a clear product strategy, and be honest about what to build, what to pause and what to stop.
 - Define the core capabilities: virtual keys, budgets and spend limits, model access policies, usage reporting and audit.
 - Consider how the gateway works for self-hosted and Cloud customers. Work closely with engineering and our Cloud team on deployment questions.
 - Help define how the enterprise gateway is packaged and sold, together with Sales, Finance and leadership.
LEAD ACROSS TEAMS
 - Work with a dedicated engineering team, and with design, as one product team.
 - Coordinate with teams that own nearby areas, such as identity and access management, governance, billing and the Cloud experience.
 - Keep leadership, Sales and Customer Success informed, and bring them clear recommendations.
REQUIREMENTS
MUST-HAVES
 - Experience as a PM for AI infrastructure, developer platforms or LLM tooling (for example AI gateways, model APIs, or AI platform products), or for enterprise admin and governance products (for example access control, policy, spend management or audit).
 - Hands-on experience with partner or vendor deals: you have negotiated terms, not only managed relationships.
 - A strong grasp of usage-based pricing, unit costs and consumption forecasting.
 - Comfort talking with enterprise buyers: platform engineers, security teams and IT leaders.
 - Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.
 - Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.
 - Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition 
NICE-TO-HAVES
 - You have built or run an LLM gateway or proxy, or worked closely with tools like LiteLLM, Portkey or similar.
 - Experience with products that run both self-hosted and as SaaS.
 - You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.
 - You’ve worked on products involving third-party APIs, authentication, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems.
 - You’ve built products alongside developer communities, contributors, or external ecosystems.
Why join us?
At n8n, you’ll work on the heart of the product experience - shaping how builders go from an idea to a workflow they trust in production. Your work will influence some of the most fundamental parts of n8n: how people build, connect services, access powerful capabilities, understand what’s happening in their workflows, and scale from simple automation to complex AI-powered systems.
You’ll join n8n at a stage where the product and company are scaling rapidly, but there is still enormous opportunity to define what a world-class automation building experience should feel like. You’ll have the autonomy to identify important problems, work deeply with users and technical teams, and turn ambitious ideas into product experiences people rely on every day.

 - A domain mid-transformation: You'll join KYCB as it shifts from manual checks to agentic automation.
 - High-stakes impact: Your work will touch every Qonto customer, at every stage of their relationship with us.
 - A growing scope: As Qonto opens new markets and legal forms, your remit will keep expanding.

You'll report to Quentin https://www.linkedin.com/in/quentin-guironnet/?locale=en, Director of Product for Customer Lifecycle. Quentin started his career as a consultant in Paris before spending four years building products for a challenger bank in Kuala Lumpur, and he's been shaping Qonto's product org since 2021.

title: Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
ABOUT PLEO
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We're looking for a Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations to join our Revenue Operations at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the technical and operational infrastructure that enables Pleo’s revenue organisation to scale and be part of cross-functional programs as we scale Pleo's customer and revenue lifecycle. If you're excited about solving complex architectural challenges at the intersection of business systems and data and are passionate about SaaS, fintech, and modern Revenue Operations, then this is the opportunity for you!
WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 
You’ll report to our Director of Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Sales, Customer Success, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Customer Onboarding. Our team of Revenue Operations professionals is highly collaborative and dedicated to building a scalable, reliable, and connected revenue operating system. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, Business Systems, and Finance to ensure success.
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
As a Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations, you will:
 - Lead complex technical programs across the revenue technology ecosystem – from discovery and requirements definition through architecture design, implementation, UAT, launch, and post-launch adoption.
 - Translate requirements bidirectionally – turn complex commercial challenges into precise technical specs for Engineering and Data teams, while breaking down technical trade-offs, system dependencies, and risks for business stakeholders.
 - Drive revenue systems and CRM initiatives – optimize architecture and end-to-end data flows across lead-to-opportunity, sales-to-onboarding handoffs, renewal, churn risk, and billing operations.
 - Identify and eliminate technical and operational debt – architect future-state solutions rather than quick fixes, automating manual workflows and improving data integrity across critical revenue systems.
 - Champion modern automation and AI-enabled RevOps capabilities – integrate intelligent workflows, predictive customer health signals, and agent-based workflows to accelerate commercial productivity.
WHAT YOU BRING 
You’ll thrive in this role if you have:
 - 5+ years of Technical Program Management experience – a proven track record of managing complex technical programs involving multi-system integrations, data models, APIs, and technical dependencies.
 - A strong understanding of the SDLC and revenue mechanics – deep comfort with software development workflows (Agile/hybrid) paired with a solid grasp of the B2B revenue lifecycle (lead routing, pipeline, onboarding, retention, expansion).
 - System architecture fluency – the ability to challenge technical designs, evaluate failure scenarios, define sources of truth, and ensure long-term scalability.
 - Exceptional stakeholder management and influence – strong executive communication skills, high cross-functional influence without direct authority, and the ability to lead governance, risk tracking, and UAT.
 - Experience with HubSpot or another enterprise CRM, modern data warehouses (SQL querying), CPQ/billing tools, or integration middleware.
 - A background in SaaS, fintech, payments, spend management, or a high-growth digital environment.
WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU
This role is a good fit for you if:
 - You love being the technical bridge between revenue leaders and software/data engineers, translating strategy into scalable technical execution.
 - You think in systems, data flows, and dependencies, and prefer fixing root causes rather than patching symptoms.
 - You want true ownership of strategic programs and enjoy driving them through technical delivery to measurable business adoption.
This role is not a good fit for you if:
 - Your TPM experience is primarily administrative (focused only on timelines, meeting notes, and status reports without understanding the underlying technical architecture).
 - You are uncomfortable discussing APIs, data schemas, integrations, and failure modes directly with engineers.
 - You need fully defined requirements handed to you rather than proactively untangling ambiguity and challenging assumptions.
HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE 
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:
 - Map Pleo's revenue systems landscape, data flows, and sources of truth, taking ownership of active high-priority technical initiatives.
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, and commercial leaders to streamline requirements gathering, UAT, and release governance.
 - Grow your skills in scaling cutting-edge RevOps infrastructure, introducing automation and AI-enabled workflows as Pleo expands across markets.

description:
As **Product Owner Account Administration**, you help the squad own every client process at account and user level; deposits, withdrawals, corporate actions, personal data, account security with one ambition: make the IBKR client portal redundant.
You translate the Product Manager’s vision into structured workflows the squad can build from, and keep the backlog focused on real client and business value.
This is an entry-level product role for mid-career professionals ready to grow into larger product responsibilities.
**What you’ll do**
* Support day-to-day product planning and execution for client-facing administrative processes.
* Gather requirements from users, customer support and stakeholders.
* Collect and summarise user feedback and usage data to find improvement opportunities.
* Draft user stories, acceptance criteria and wireframes with Engineering and Design.
* Own and prioritise the backlog for administrative client processes, balancing feasibility with client value and risk.

* Set clear sprint goals, track progress and help remove blockers.

You’re curious about product development and enjoy improving processes that directly affect the client experience.

* An annual training budget of €2,000, freely allocated to your professional development.
* Team outings, social drinks, and an annual weekend trip with the entire team.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Ready for a challenge?**
--------------------------
Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.
Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.
**About this role**
-------------------
Commerce Platform exists to build and evolve Just Eat Takeaway's foundational business capabilities that empower teams to deliver value faster. As Product Manager for the Enablement Platform, you will be accountable for managing the roadmap and strategy for our critical platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and proactively communicating this with senior stakeholders.
The Mobile Platform team is JET's Android and iOS centre of expertise. Our mission is to help product teams create great customer experiences faster by solving shared technical and platform problems once, at scale.
We own the foundations that every product team builds on: navigation, deep-linking, permissions, onboarding, consent and privacy, performance monitoring, analytics and experimentation, push notifications, the CI/CD pipeline, release management, and app-store presence.
As Product Manager for the Enablement Platform, your customers are the engineering and product teams who depend on mobile platform capabilities to ship their own features. Success means they can build, test, and deploy through our platform without waiting on us, and when they do need us, the path is clear, fast, and well-documented.
**What you'll do**
------------------
*Platform strategy and KPIs*
* Manage the mobile apps roadmap and strategy, creating a vision that enables stream-aligned teams to deliver experiences more quickly
* Define and instrument platform KPIs linked to business outcomes. Examples include crash-free session rates, self-serve adoption, app-store ratings and sentiment, deployment frequency, deeplink reliability, onboarding completion, and app launch performance
* Conduct user and industry research to identify gaps and opportunities to deliver value faster
* Monitor and analyse performance metrics to identify efficiency improvements and prioritise where the platform invests next
* Frame problems with data before prescribing solutions. For each user problem, identify the specific metrics it could move, the supporting analysis, and the remaining unknowns
*Product development and execution*
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept to launch, collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, translate them into roadmaps, and ensure timely delivery
* Run sprint refinement sessions, kick-off meetings, and own Jira writing and OKR linking for all work coming into the mobile space
* Work with tech managers to ensure platform products are reusable, scalable, and pave the way for future user needs across multiple business domains
* Drive clarity on what can be done, bring problems to solve to the table rather than just solutions, and help the team understand where the biggest platform bottlenecks are
* Communicate the platform vision clearly across the business to drive engagement, adoption, and relevance
* Champion self-service and reduce dependency on the platform team over time, so product teams can do more without waiting
**What we're looking for in you**
---------------------------------
* Strong collaboration and relationship-building across engineering, product, and business stakeholders, based on respect and mutual support for success
* Results-driven, with the ability to execute quickly and efficiently while getting into the details when necessary
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to bring structure to problems that span multiple teams and domains
* Self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments and adapts quickly as priorities evolve
* Positive, proactive approach with a strong work ethic; celebrate team wins, own your results, and be open to giving and receiving feedback
**Requirements**
----------------
* Experience as a Product Manager in Agile software development teams, ideally with platform or infrastructure experience
* Experience with mobile platforms specifically (iOS and Android), given this is JET's mobile centre of expertise
* Proven ability to partner with engineering to critically evaluate technical solutions and trade-offs. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand the implications
* Experience managing a platform as a product to support other teams. Your customers are other builders, not end users
* Track record of defining KPIs linked to business outcomes and using data to prioritise investment
* Effective communication of complex matters to non-domain experts in a clear, simple, and concise way
* A proactive approach to finding ways to optimise processes and products
* Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to bring structure to problems that span multiple teams and domains
**Our Offer**
-------------
Just like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! With us, you can expect:
* Competitive Compensation: A salary package that recognises your performance – complemented by an open feedback culture and regular performance reviews.
* Flexibility: A permanent employment contract with hybrid work options: three days per week in our Berlin-Kreuzberg office and two days working from the comfort of your home.

title: Product Manager
description:
tl;dr 
 After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the intelligence layer for the construction industry.
 The largest construction enterprises in Europe, with a combined project volume of over €30bn annually, rely on Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.
 Construction has the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM, PDFs, drawings, 3D models, images, calculations. At Kuro you can tackle the hardest applied AI problems everyday.
 Curious about the bigger product challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.
 About us 
 Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.
 Kuro is the intelligent project data system for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible.
 After one year on the market leading construction enterprises with a combined construction volume >30 billion annually use Kuro everyday to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.
 We are 16 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of ex-technical founders and builders that are ambitious and kind.
 Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin 
 The Opportunity 
 As Product Manager , you'll work on the platform at the heart of Kuro's product, building the foundational capabilities that enable our teams to deliver faster and scale with confidence. You'll help defining the strategy and execution, from the data domain model, project graphs, and ontologies to workflow abstractions and essential services such as permissions, document versioning, lineage, and collaboration.
 Working closely with the Co-Founder & CPO, platform engineering, design, and our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), you'll ensure every investment accelerates the development of future use cases, making the platform more extensible, scalable, and powerful with every release.
 What You'll Do 
 Be an active voice in roadmap creation, balancing immediate platform needs with long-term strategic investments.
 Lead strategic initiatives to capture key decisions across the project lifecycle and evolve Kuro's scalable data domain model.
 Define success metrics, use production data to iterate on platform capabilities, and communicate releases across the organization.
 Make informed decisions on prioritization, scope, and sequencing, partnering with leadership on major architectural and new product bets.
 Discover opportunities with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and translate complex operational challenges into clear product requirements.
 Your profile 
 5+ years of product management experience building technical products, such as AI, automation, developer tooling, or enterprise software.
 Proven experience shipping data platform products, APIs, or graph- and ontology-based systems.
 Strong understanding of how LLM-powered products behave in production and the challenges of building AI-native products.
 Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and balancing short-term needs with long-term platform investments.
 Passion for understanding users' day-to-day workflows and a willingness to become a domain expert in the construction industry.
 Fluent in German, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.
 Bonus: 
 Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or workflow abstraction frameworks.
 Founder experience or experience building products in an early-stage startup.
 Experience in construction technology (ConTech), AEC software, or a related industry.
 Why Kuro

title: Senior Product Manager - Content Integrity
description:
Why This Role
AVIV Group runs some of Europe’s largest property marketplaces, including SeLoger, immowelt and Immoweb. Users make one of the biggest financial decisions of their lives based on what they see there, and that only works if the content is real, accurate and current. You will own content integrity: the products that decide whether a listing is authentic and compliant, what happens when it isn’t, and how that signal steers visibility and liquidity. This is a founding role, with the opportunity to define the product strategy.
The Team You’ll Join
You’ll join Trust & Safety as a founding member, working with engineering, data science and operations. You’ll partner closely with Search, Recommendations and Notifications, and with external BPOs on quality and guidelines. This is a central team, so you’ll also work with our country organisations, who choose whether to adopt what you build.
What You’ll Own
 Strategy and roadmap: Set the vision for trustworthy listing content and turn it into a prioritised roadmap, delivered end to end with engineering, data science and operations.
 Detection products: Own the ML and rules-based systems that catch misleading behaviour and policy violations, including the precision/recall trade-off and the evidence of what the system misses.
 Integrity as a ranking signal: Turn integrity judgements into signals that shape visibility, and decide when to remove, demote, warn or do nothing.
 Enforcement experience: Own what users are told when content is actioned, how they fix it and how they appeal.
 Moderation and compliance platform: Own the review tooling, queues and automation that let a small operations team work consistently at volume, and translate written policy into enforceable product logic.
 Metrics and adoption: Define and baseline the domain metrics, then move them, and drive adoption across our country organisations.
 What We’ll Achieve Together
Success means measurable improvements, not just new processes. We expect you to help us:
 Reduce the prevalence of violating content and users’ exposure to it.
 Improve detection precision and recall, with results that can be independently verified.
 Increase the automation rate and shorten time to action.
 Keep the appeal overturn rate under control as enforcement scales.
 Get markets to choose and adopt the tools you build.
 The exact measures will be agreed based on the priorities and baseline when you join.
 What You Bring
We care more about what you have built and improved than a particular title. You bring:
 Around five years in product management, including ownership of ML or data products where you were accountable for model quality and decision thresholds.
 Experience in content integrity, marketplace quality or trust & safety at a consumer platform or marketplace.
 Work at the boundary of integrity and discovery, using quality or trust signals in search ranking, recommendations or feed visibility.
 A working partnership with policy and moderation operations, such as writing requirements for reviewers, building review tooling or auditing human decisions.
 Strong analytical judgement and clear written English.
 Nice to have: French or German; familiarity with the EU Digital Services Act or comparable regimes; experience in a central platform model serving several brands or markets; an adversarial instinct for how a new feature will be gamed.
How We Work at AVIV
 Role
 Our Leadership Behaviours describe not only what we expect people to deliver, but how we expect them to deliver it. For this role, four behaviours will be particularly important:
 Live for the Customer. You protect user trust, starting with real impact on buyers, sellers and agents and ending with proof that it changed.
 Data Leads. Judgment Wins. You set a clear baseline, reject vanity metrics and combine data with judgment to make the call.
 Decide Fast. Deliver Hard. You bring a recommendation, not a menu, and make reversible decisions quickly with the best information available.
 Simplify to Scale. You build solutions that work across teams and markets rather than one-off fixes.
What to Expect From the Hiring Process
We want our hiring process to be focused, transparent and respectful of your time. You can typically expect 3 interviews with the people you would work most closely with. Depending on the role, we may also include a practical case or skills assessment relevant to the work you would be doing. We’ll explain the process from the start and keep you informed throughout.
 About AVIV Group
 Join one of the world’s largest and most innovative digital real estate tech companies.
Backed by global investment leaders KKR and CPP Investments, AVIV Group is reshaping the way people across Europe buy, sell, rent, lease, and value real estate.
With a strong presence in Europe, we power some of the region’s most recognized digital real estate platforms across various countries – including Immoweb, SeLoger, and Meilleurs Agents (France’s leading real estate valuation platform), alongside immowelt and Homeday (one of Germany’s fastest-growing PropTech companies). Our European footprint is complemented by our dynamic tech and engineering hubs in Romania and Croatia.
Our mission? We simplify life’s most important transactions. By combining data, technology, and human expertise, we empower millions of people to find their perfect home!
Help us shape the future of real estate.

title: Senior Product Manager Compliance & Risk
description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.
 Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.
 Part of something bigger
 Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.
Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.
We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.
 Your Hiring Experience Matters
 Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.
If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.
 The Banking Compliance & Risk team at Shine
 The Compliance & Risk team keeps Shine's customers and accounts safe from financial crime. Our mission is to detect and prevent fraud and money laundering and to secure customer accounts, without making life harder for the business owners who make up almost all of our customers.
The team owns anti-money laundering (risk scoring, transaction monitoring and alerts, suspicious activity reports, sanctions and PEP screening) and fraud detection and prevention (real-time monitoring, pattern analysis, case investigation and resolution). It also owns the back-office products that our AML and fraud employees use every day.
Every decision this team makes carries a cost on both sides. A missed fraud pattern costs customers money and puts our banking licence at risk. A false alert freezes the account of a plumber on the day they need to pay a supplier. We must get both right, across multiple countries, under regulators that keep changing the rules.
The work also decides how much manual review our compliance and operations teams carry. Sharper risk scoring, better alert rules and good case tooling reduce the number of alerts an analyst opens and the time each one takes.
 Your role as a Senior Product Manager
 As the Product Manager of the Compliance & Risk team, you own the product strategy for how Shine detects and prevents financial crime and fraud. You build deep knowledge of AML and fraud regulation across France, Germany, the Netherlands and Denmark, and turn it into products that analysts can work with quickly and that legitimate customers barely notice.
You work every day with an engineering manager, a designer, and the compliance, fraud and operations teams who use what we build. You need enough technical depth to question trade-offs on detection logic, rules and models, and data pipelines, and to bring technically driven opportunities into the team's priorities.
 Your Responsibilities Will Include
 Own the AML and fraud roadmap. Set the strategy for risk scoring, transaction monitoring, sanctions and PEP screening, and real-time fraud detection, and decide what we build, buy or change in each area.
 Run the team on outcomes. Define KPIs such as false positive rate, fraud loss rate, time to resolve a case, and the share of alerts closed without manual review, and tie every project to at least one of them.
 Turn regulation into scoped work. Follow regulatory change in our four markets, including the EU AML package and the payment rules on fraud and strong authentication, and translate each change into work with an owner and a date.
 Make security proportionate to risk. Shape the customer experience of strong authentication, phishing protection and account alerts so that friction rises only where risk rises.
 Build the back-office tools with the analysts. Sit with the people who work the alerts and cases, measure where their time goes, and ship tooling that removes the slowest steps.
 Work with engineering on data and detection. Own the trade-offs between rules and models, data quality, and where AI can triage alerts, with explainability and an audit trail a regulator can inspect.
 Set the strategic direction for our transaction monitoring and behavioral analytics across countries.
 Partner with compliance leadership. Write requirements that hold up in an audit, and give compliance officers the evidence they need to approve changes quickly.
 Drive discovery and delivery. Talk to customers and analysts every week, look for fixes that solve several problems at once, and mix structural improvements with quick wins.
 Manage incidents. Lead the product response to fraud spikes, alert backlogs and detection failures, and follow up until the root cause is fixed.
 📍 Job located in Berlin; Amsterdam; Copenhagen; Madrid with possibility of two remote working days per week
 About You
 5+ years as a Product Manager in a start-up or scale-up, with banking or fintech as a strong plus
 Experience building AML, fraud, KYC, transaction monitoring or sanctions screening products, or comparable risk products in payments or marketplaces
 Proven expertise in product discovery, delivery and data analysis, including pulling and reading the data yourself to size a problem
 Working knowledge of system architecture, data pipelines, rules engines or machine learning based detection
 Experience managing incidents and bugs and holding a high bar for operational reliability
 Comfort in a regulated environment where requirements change and not everything is defined up front
 Ability to work with compliance officers and fraud analysts and to make decisions with them on incomplete eviden
